name: Phi-4-multimodal-instruct
notes: THREE-PART MODEL -- image, audio, and text all enter the same LLM. (1) IMAGE: CLIP ViT-L/14 at crop_size 448 (embd_layer.image_embd_layer.embedding_cls 'tune_image'), then the DYNAMIC CROPPING / HD TRANSFORM that decides prefill cost: use_hd_transform true, hd_transform_order 'sub_glb', preprocessor_config dynamic_hd 36, and image_token_compression_cls 'avg_pool_2d'. HD transform resizes the input to a large square and emits the global view plus up to 36 sub-crops of 336x336 (sub_glb = sub-crops then global). VISION TOKENS: each 336 crop through CLIP-14 is (336/14)^2 = 576 patches, then avg_pool_2d halves each spatial axis -> 144 tokens per crop. At dynamic_hd 36 that is up to 37 * 144 = 5,328 vision tokens per image, versus 144 for the single-crop default. DOMINANCE: VISION DOMINATES whenever HD transform engages (5,328 vs a ~100-token prompt, ~50:1); roughly balanced only on the default single 448 crop. The dynamic_hd knob is the single biggest cost lever in this record -- it moves vision tokens by 37x. The ViT is adapted by LoRA, not frozen: vision_lora r 256, lora_alpha 512, targeting self_attn.qkv_proj/o_proj and mlp.gate_up_proj/down_proj across all layers. (2) AUDIO: NeMo 'cascades' encoder, 24 blocks (num_blocks), d_model/attention_dim 1024, 16 heads, linear_units 1536, time_reduction 8, input_size 80 mel bins, T5 relative-attention bias with t5_bias_max_distance 500, causal true (left_chunk 18) -- so the audio encoder is chunk-aware and streamable, unlike Whisper's bidirectional one. audio_compression_rate 8. Also LoRA-adapted (speech_lora r 320). (3) LLM: Phi-4 dense decoder, 32 layers, hidden 3072, 24 heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, intermediate 8192, vocab 200,064, partial_rotary_factor 0.75 (only 75% of head dims get RoPE), full_attn_mod 1, max_position 131,072 against original_max_position_embeddings 4096. ARCHITECTURE = dense (all three parts dense). CONTEXT_SCALING = LongRoPE: rope_scaling carries a long_factor array of per-dimension rescale factors, stretching 4,096 -> 131,072, with short_factor implied for the base window. rope_theta 1e4. KV CACHE: 32 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 131,072 B/token (128 KiB). At 131,072 ctx that is 16.0 GiB per sequence at bf16. params_b 5.574 = HF API safetensors total (5,574,460,384) -- the '4B' Phi-4 text model plus vision and audio encoders.
